propositions: Live DC rich-text tests fail when outbound/inbound differs operate against a stale JQL search snapshot (description field remains None) while local state has been updated, causing the echo pass to re-diff and emit inbound mutations that clobber local back to stale values.

The inbound differ consults the current snapshot without a baseline guard, allowing a STALE post-write snapshot to trigger inbound mutations when snapshot!=local and baseline=local, creating a data-loss window where inbound overwrites the just-pushed description.

The test's defensive wait on search index visibility (_wait_until_search_reflects) times out after 240s because the ephemeral Jira DC's background Lucene reindex is unbounded and may never reflect the write within any fixed budget.

The fix requires a scoped snapshot overlay that direct-GETs fresh mirrored fields (summary/description/priority/status/assignee) for bound jira_keys present in the search snapshot, merging them into curr_snapshot before the echo pass differs run, ensuring inbound sees jira==local and does not clobber.
